subject: Future Tech
title: Quantum Finance Models
description: A quick, practical guide to Quantum Finance Models.

hook.text: Wall Street runs millions of simulations to price risk. Quantum computers could do it exponentially faster.

buildup.text: Monte Carlo simulations are the workhorses of finance. They estimate odds by running millions of random trials.

discovery.text: Quantum amplitude estimation achieves the same accuracy with far fewer samples than classical Monte Carlo.

twist.text: Real financial quantum advantage needs error-corrected machines. Today's noisy chips can't handle real trades.

climax.text: JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, and HSBC all have quantum teams exploring portfolio optimization and fraud detection.

punchline.text: Finance may be quantum's first killer app.

quiz.question: What classical technique could quantum computers accelerate for finance?
